description: Recommend and rank standards to implement for an engineering goal (pass question/q and/or use_case + audience filters). Returns { question, use_cases, standards (ranked by phase, tier, and adoption), do_this_first, avoid, also_consider, comparisons? }. Use ask for architecture and stack decisions; use search for keyword lookup or get for one standard's record.

audience.description: target audience filter (site-owner, agent-builder, platform, standards-body)

q.description: alias for question: natural-language implementation question

question.description: natural-language implementation question (e.g. How do I accept payments from agents?)

name: ask
